_extraction_context.source_title: Did Gumroad Just Get Dumped By Paypal
_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "We wanted to inform you that PayPal has suspended Gumroad's use of their service. As a result, we can no longer process payouts to PayPal accounts. We've invested heavily in direct bank transfers for nearly every country. We encourage you to connect a bank account directly to your Gumroad account to ensure uninterrupted payouts."
_extraction_context.subject_exact: Forum post (polycount.com, Oct 16, 2024) quotes Gumroad email stating PayPal suspended Gumroad's use of their service as of October 2024, ending PayPal payouts; Gumroad stated it had invested heavily in direct bank transfers for nearly every country and encouraged sellers to connect bank accounts directly
local_qualifiers: polycount.com (Oct 16, 2024): quotes Gumroad email: PayPal suspended Gumroad service; PayPal payouts ended; Gumroad claims bank transfers available for 'nearly every country'; sellers urged to switch to bank account
